name: SIGMAXYZ Inc.
summary: SIGMAXYZ Inc. provides business consulting and investment services in Japan. The company offers consulting services for digital transformation, program and project management, ERP cloud migration services, business process transformation, innovations, M&A and platform strategy planning, construction of multi-sided platforms, and other. It also provides new business development, business investment, establishment and operation of joint ventures, development and delivery of joint services, and incubation services. In addition, the company offers M&A advisory services, and financial EDI services. SIGMAXYZ Inc. was founded in 2008 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.
